definitions.explanation: East and west as directions, or East and West as cultures; in set phrases, everywhere.

examples.japanese: {東西|とうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧。
{東西|とうざい}⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
{東西|とうざい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Cultural exchange between East and West is advancing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古今|ここん}→古今：28576_kokon⟧{東西|とうざい}、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In all times and places, the feelings of parents for their children are the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東西|とうざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧、⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: This country stretches from east to west, and the climate varies greatly by region.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {東西|とうざい}{南北|なんぼく}: north, south, east and west; in all directions
- {東西|とうざい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: Eastern and Western cultures
- ⟦{古今|ここん}→古今：28576_kokon⟧{東西|とうざい}: in all times and places
- {東西|とうざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: long from east to west

CULTURAL NOTE:
In kabuki, bunraku and sumo ceremonies, a formal announcement opens with the call {東西|とざい}、{東西|とうざい} ("Hear ye, hear ye"), with the first word shortened to ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ざい.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧: north and south
